season.evidence: SummitPost route page lists Spring, Summer, Fall; web search (Cascade Climbers, Mountaineers) shows snow on Easy Pass trail in mid-June and wildflowers late July; Peakbagger Douglas logs Jun and Sep; peak months Jun 22, Jul 118, Aug 46, Sep 15. Matches stored Jun-Sep.

otherTracksConsidered.why: The file is a round trip from Colonial Creek (48.6856,-121.0926) up Thunder Creek and Park Creek Pass to the summit: the Fremont Glacier line, ~24 km from the Easy Pass trailhead pin and never near the Fisher Creek / Douglas Glacier approach. Fremont Glacier already holds a track.

notes: The only SummitPost file is the Fremont Glacier route from Colonial Creek, not Douglas. Douglas Glacier left without a track; no pins proposed.
